title: 5 Betər
overview: The film's so-called heroes, Elmaddin and Natig, have erased the videotape of an expensive wedding. Since the tape was crucial to the hosts—Mr. Qanboy and his wife, Sudaba—they staged a fake wedding for their daughter. Knyaz, the film's fake groom, is a representative from a "rent-a-groom" agency.
